title: Hollywood Sign Hiking: Explore Griffith Park
includes: Photos of you, for memories that last
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Reach the famous Hollywood Sign on a universally accessible hike through the picturesque Griffith Park Hills. This 3-hour tour allows you to discover the fascinating history of this iconic symbol of Los Angeles while enjoying stunning views of the city. A French Guide will accompany you to share captivating anecdotes about Hollywood and its evolution over the years. Whether you are solo, with family or friends, this adventure guarantees you memorable memories.

 - 3-Hour Griffith Park Hiking with a French Guide
 - Small group (maximum 10 people) for a personalized experience
 - 360° panoramic views of Los Angeles and the Hollywood Sign
 - Accessible to all, except wheelchair users
